sources.title: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct model card
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint: 30.5B total, 3.3B activated, 128 experts with eight activated, native 262,144-token context, non-thinking mode and function calling. Provides text generation examples and describes repository-scale coding use.

sources.title: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM / qwen3_moe; 48 layers, 128 experts, eight experts per token, max_position_embeddings 262144. Text causal-LM configuration has no vision/audio components.

sources.title: Checkpoint LICENSE
sources.evidence: The checkpoint repository contains the Apache License, Version 2.0.

sources.title: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Release table explicitly lists qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-instruct on 2025-07-31 as a Qwen3-based text/code generation model.

sources.title: Qwen organization
sources.evidence: Official organization identifies Qwen as the model family built by Alibaba Cloud.

sources.title: Checkpoint files
sources.evidence: Public repository exposes sixteen Safetensors weight shards, configuration, tokenizer and tool parser files.

sources.title: Checkpoint commit history
sources.evidence: Initial commit, weight upload, model-card updates and license creation are dated July 31, 2025, corroborating the developer's release table.
